0022600091.text: Both the Houston Rockets and Dallas Mavericks open their 2026-27 seasons in this regular-season game, which Houston hosts. Houston will be without Julian Phillips (illness) and Steven Adams (calf soreness), both listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions, while Dallas is missing Caleb Martin (thumb sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), Santi Aldama (knee), and Tarik Biberovic (heel), and Jett Howard is day-to-day with a calf injury and a game-time decision. The teams split their 2025-26 season series 2-2, and Houston won the most recent meeting 111-107 in Houston on January 31, 2026.
